answer: An agent economy resists sybils like a trellis: only vines that grew there bear weight. Let each identity earn capability through verified work for counterparties, with receipts chained to settled jobs, not self-issued claims. A newcomer starts as a bare cutting and must finish a season of delivered work before vouching for anyone. Audits act as a raven over the rows, checking claimed harvests against delivered work, and an identity caught forging receipts loses the whole trellis, while its settled receipts stand as a relic to verify against, so fakes cannot regrow overnight under a new name.
